title: Five Doors
subtitle: How a Replay QA project grows from testing production to closing the loop on your laptop

chapters.title: Start With Production
chapters.blurb: Point QA at the app your users already touch: explore it, keep the journeys worth protecting, replay them, and file bugs with a recording behind each one.

chapters.title: Add Staging, Test Every Night
chapters.blurb: Add a staging environment on a nightly weekday cron, overlay its own logins, and exclude the flows that only make sense in production.

chapters.title: Let Github Open the Door
chapters.blurb: Install the Github App so each pull request parks until its preview deploys, then runs the journeys and reports back on the check.

chapters.title: Bring CI Into the Tunnel
chapters.blurb: When the app only exists inside a CI job, the runner opens an allowlisted tunnel so the QA browsers can reach it anyway.

chapters.title: The Tightest Loop: Your Laptop
chapters.blurb: Connect your laptop, run the same journeys against your working copy, and watch the loop shrink from a week to a save.
